title: Gossip Girl Tour
blurb:
If you're a fan of the Gossip Girl book series or TV show (or both!) and you want to see locations from the famous and popular television series up close and personal, you should know that it's possible to take Gossip Girl Tour. You'll be able to capture the spirit of the TV show, while you get some great photos and selfies! You'll feel just like one of the show's characters, such as Blair Waldorf or Serena van der Woodsen. You'll be able to sit back and relax as your pedicab operator shows you Gossip Girl locations.

30-Minute Tour covers Central Park locations

1-Hour Tour covers Central Park, Upper West Side Locations

1.5-Hour Tour covers Central Park, Upper West Side Locations, a little bit of the Upper East Side

2-Hour Tour covers Upper East Side, Central Park, Upper West Side Locations

2.5-Hour Tour covers Upper East Side, Central Park, Upper West Side, and a little bit of Midtown Locations

3-Hour Tour covers Midtown, Upper East Side, Central Park, Upper West Side Locations
